events.title: Full Moon Meditation — February
events.description:
Join us for a transformative evening with the energy of the full moon — a powerful time for meditation and reflection.

Meditating during a full moon can help shift negative emotions and patterns into a more positive space, offering a profound sense of renewal. It also enhances mental clarity making it an ideal time to realign, refocus, and find inner balance.

Meditating in a group is a transformative practice that helps us connect deeply with our essence. When we gather with a shared intention, the collective energy amplifies serenity and peace, uplifting everyone present.

Don't miss this chance to reconnect with your inner self and the energy of the full moon.

BENEFITS YOU WILL EXPERIENCE
-> Heightened self-awareness & emotional release
-> Powerful manifestation of personal intentions
-> Deep inner peace & relaxation
events.organizer_name: I Meditate NY (Art of Living NYC)

events.title: RESCHEDULED to 2/1 - Freeish American Museum of Natural History Visit!
events.description:
As of 1/22/2026:
The weather service has said there will be a blizzard! I sure hope everyone can still make it next week! I have updated the event to 2/1.

Hi Everyone! 👋🏾👋🏾

Our last event was a doozy! 🥴

Let's talk about the next one! 📓 🖊️

Our next museum is a first for our group! We're going to the American Museum of Natural History, one of the absolute best museums in NYC! Established in 1869, AMNH has a lovely gem and mineral collection, dinosaur bones, a library, fantastic animal specimens and more! 🦕

We will not be able to see everything in one day, so we can absolutely plan to come back. I booked 30 tickets. In order to stay with the group it is important that you come on time! It may be very difficult to find us after we go in. 🦖

NYS residents can always book their own tickets with the pay as you wish option online.

You don't want to miss this! Hope to see you there! 🎨🖼️🗽

events.title:
Language Exchange Sunday 
EN · ES · FR · RU · JP · ZH · PT · IT
events.description:
The concept of our language exchange event is to provide a relaxed and friendly atmosphere for a gathering of folks to practice languages whilst making new friends and sharing experiences with people from all around the globe.
**The fee is to cover group costs: $5 (Cash or Venmo only)**
English, Spanish, Russian, French, Japanese, Italian, and Mandarin are commonly heard, but the mix changes week to week.

Please look for an organizer when you arrive and we'll help you make a nametag and get you seated.

Please note, this is a social event and not a dating event so please avoid any kind of interaction that may make other attendees feel uncomfortable. If you feel like someone is acting inappropriately, please approach one of the organizers so that we can handle it.

Sometimes we take photos at our events to preserve memory of our gatherings and for social media promotion.

events.title: Langroops NYC BROOKLYN 🗣 Language Exchange (Sunday) Free!
events.description:
All languages welcome!
===

Practice your English, and help other people practice English
Practica tu español, y ayuda a otros a practicar español
Pratiquez le français, et aidez les autres à pratiquer le français
练习说中文，而帮助别人练习说中文

✅RSVP on Meetup is required to join this event.
**Please comment with the languages you are coming to speak and practice!**

**💌 Stay in touch:**
Facebook group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/langroopsnyc
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/langroops/
Telegram: [https://t.me/+eL8C6JWIghQzOWYx](https://t.me/+eL8C6JWIghQzOWYx)
We have an updates group on Whatsapp - please comment if you want to be added.

🤷‍♂️🌎Who is this meetup for?
Anyone who is learning a language and wants to practice speaking with native speakers and get tips from other learners!
All languages and levels are welcome!

🤷‍♂️🗣How it works:
Please look for an organizer when you arrive and we'll help you make a nametag and get seated :)

We usually gather around 1-3 tables depending on the languages people want to practice. Usually we get interest in English, Spanish, French & Chinese. Occasionally Portuguese, Japanese & more! If you comment with the language you want to practice, you have higher chances of practicing that language ✌

You should be spending about half the time practicing and half the time helping others ✌

**This event is FREE**
💵 We accept contributions via Venmo before or after the event (@langroops).
*Your contributions allow us to continue holding this on other fun language learning events!*

🚫We kindly ask participants to avoid any kind of solicitation at our events.
🙅‍♂️This is not a dating event, so please avoid any kind of interaction that may make other attendees feel uncomfortable. If you feel like someone is acting inappropriately, please approach one of the organizers so that we can handle it.

📷\*We sometimes take pictures at our events for memories and social media - we will try and notify you beforehand

🌎If you can't make this event you can also check out our online events at www.langroops.com

🤷‍♂️Who are we?
Langroops is a hub of volunteer lead language exchange communities that conduct weekly free events for a wide variety of languages. We pride ourselves in being a safe place for sincere language learners to come and practice with native speakers.

FAQs:
❓Can I come if I am a beginner/haven't started learning yet?
👉Language learners and enthusiasts of all levels are welcome! That said, you will get the most out of the event if you can speak at least a little in the language you are learning.

❓Can I come late?
👉Yes! You can come at any time you like after the event has started.

❓What time does the event end?
👉The official times for the event are 3-6 PM.

❓How often does this event take place?
👉Every weekend!

❓Can I move between tables?
👉Of course! If you are practicing multiple languages you can move between tables as you wish. Just make sure you spend some of the time helping people with your native language!

❓Where is the English table?
👉Every table is an English table! Just go to the table with the sign for your native language and meet English speakers learning your language to practice with.

❓Is there an X language table?
👉All tables are based on attendance, our popular tables are listed above and we try and connect people that share language interests at the event. We are happy to open a table for any language - just comment below and arrive on time :)

events.title: Sunday Night Gaming at Hex & Co. West
Cuban Salsa & Rueda de Casino Classes!
events.description:
💃🏼🕺🏼Have you ever tried **Salsa**? How about ***Cuban*** **Salsa**? Now is your chance to learn this exciting & fun dance! On **Sunday, January 4th**, we are offering a Cuban-style Salsa **BEGINNER** introduction class! The class will start its curriculum from scratch, will be in a dance studio, & will be kept comfortably small to facilitate learning, so IT DOESN’T MATTER IF YOU HAVE NEVER DANCED! Also, having a partner is not required as we constantly rotate during the class. This format gives you the opportunity to practice your steps with various partners & prepares you for the social dance scene in a safe & pressure-free environment.

The teachers, a male & female, teach progressive levels of Cuban Salsa Partner work, also known as **Casino** & **Rueda de Casino** \- an interactive group dance where there are constant partner exchanges with fun patterns executed in unison\!

🇨🇺The new session of Cuban Salsa begins on **Sunday, 1/4!** 🇨🇺

▫️**Sundays** (January 4th - 25th):

🔹**5:00-6:00pm** \| **Absolute Beginner Cuban Salsa** - **Level 1**

This class is for absolute beginners with little to no dance experience & will allow you to develop a strong foundation in Cuban Salsa in an extremely fun, stress-free atmosphere. In each 60-minute class of the four week series, students focus on developing dance fundamentals including rhythm, coordination, balance, & the specific technical aspects of Cuban Salsa, including basic steps & turn patterns, partnering technique, & the fundamental motions of Casino. Students will also learn social dancing etiquette, floorcraft, & partner safety in an extremely warm, relaxed, social & fun environment.

💲PRICE
-For First Time members & their guests, **1st Class: ONLY $15, 50% OFF!!!**
Normally $30 Drop-In!

-Level 1 full month package of **4 classes: ONLY $75** \- Normally $100\. That's 4 classes for the price of 3\!\!\!

-Payment in advance encouraged either via Credit Card: https://fuakata.square.site , Venmo: @Chris-Rogicki , Cash App: $FuakataSalsaNYC , or Zelle: Christopher.Rogicki@gmail.com

**📍Location:**
Adelante Studios
25 W31st Street
New York, NY 10001
Between Broadway & 5th Avenue
Floor 2 = Grand Ballroom Space/3,000 sq ft of Dance Floor
🗽 Herald Square/NoMad/Koreatown
🚇 **Nearby Subways:** 34th St Station on B, D, F, M, N, Q, R, & PATH trains

All classes are taught by both a male, Chris/Ryan/Mark, & female, Nayelli/Svetlana/Nikki, so women can easily follow another woman while men are following a man at the same time! They have over 26 years of training, teaching, performing, & traveling to Cuba to collaborate with the very best in the Salsa world. Feel free to contact them if you have any questions:

📨 Chris: Chris@CubanSalsaNewYork.com / 📲 908.601.3415

For those with **previous experience** dancing Cuban Salsa, we also offer a **Level 1.5/Advanced Beginner class**, also on Sundays at 5:00pm, simultaneously as the absolute beginner class. See below:

▫️**Sundays** (January 4th - 25th)

🔹**5:00 - 6:00pm** \| **Advanced Beginner/Improver Cuban Salsa & Rueda de Casino - Level 1.5**

This class is for advanced beginners that have completed our 4-week absolute beginner series & further extrapolates from key foundational motions in Cuban Salsa. In each 60-minute class of the four week series, students focus on improving & fine-tuning the core introductory elements of Casino: Exhíbela, Dile que No, Guapea, Enchufla-based patterns, closed & open position transitions, & compositional variations. Rueda de Casino, an interactive group dance involving rapid partner exchanges, will also be introduced with the goal of increasing & fortifying responsiveness in both lead & follow roles, along with spatial orientation & kinesthetic awareness. Upon completion, students will have all the necessary tools to transition to the intermediate level.

🚨 For our complete schedule & additional info, check out:

events.title: Add French-with-Art to Your Sunday Morning Routine this Coming February!
events.description:
**Start Your Sunday morning routine with French-with-Art this coming February 2026! Perfect Your French and learn about art!**
Take your French to a whole new level with French-with-Art's course taking place on **4 Sundays this coming February: 2/1; 2/8; 2/15; 11/22, 2026, from 10 am to 11 am EST** and for our friends in Europe **from 4 to 5 pm Euro-Time.**

**Intermediate and advanced levels.**
Join us for this unique opportunity to immerse yourself in fun live interactive online sessions of French and Art! You'll practice your French while learning about the master works from the world's great collections.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* **Practice your French, both speaking and listening skills**
* **Increase your French vocabulary**
* **Learn about great works of art**
* **Enhance your observational skills**
* **Meet other Francophiles**
* **And have fun!**

You'll receive vocabulary lists as well as the list of works we'll explore.

**We'll be meeting online with Zoom.**

**Cost: $158 for the 4-session course.**
The sessions will be run by me, Anne. I'm a native English/French bilingual and lecturer at the Metropolitan Museum of Art for over 10 years.

**SPACE IS VERY LIMITED TO ENSURE INTERACTIVITY!!**
**To join you need to register on the sign up page on my website here below:**
[www.arteling.net/sign-up-programs](www.arteling.net/sign-up-programs)
for more info: send us an email at french.with.art.com
our website: [www.arteling.net](www.arteling.net)
***Note: an RSVP on this page does not mean you are registered. Registration at the above link is required to participate so you'll need to click on the above link, which will take you to my registration page.***

From the participants:

"Anne's interactive French with Art classes are stimulating and fun. Providing her students with the vocabulary they can use to react to the artworks, Anne listens closely to and celebrates each person's input. Patient and complimentary, she has created a safe haven where we are not afraid to make mistakes, as we improve our language skills. I feel that I have greatly developed my observation skills, as Anne encourages us to look deeply into each painting."

"If you wish to practice speaking French while at the same time improving your knowledge of art, French-with-Art is the class for you. Anne is a patient and encouraging facilitator whose small classes ensure that all have an opportunity to participate. She provides relevant vocabulary prior to each class and asks thoughtful questions to encourage interaction. French-with-Art has helped me become more confidant expressing myself in French and has significantly expanded my appreciation of art and its various styles. I would highly recommend it."
